pieces.text: Even so, the big man's still
waiting things out.
I'm, of course, referring to my comrade,
the leader of all revolutionaries
in the world.
You may know him as Dragon.
Oh, you're talking about my dad.
Yes, that's the plan.
When your dad makes a move with that army
of his, then I shall do some
maneuvering of my own.
Call it my grand comeback tour.
If I were to escape from this place now,
I'd just end up on a sea of wanted lists.
Hmm.
Da da da da da da da.
Da!
